title: Chapter 11: State Legislature – Legislative Assembly and Legislative Council

blocks.content: Articles 168 to 212 of the Indian Constitution deal with the State Legislature.

items: Remember the exact range: Articles 168 to 212 pertain to the State Legislature.
Competitive exams frequently ask which part of the Constitution and which specific Article range cover the powers and procedures of the Legislative Assembly and Legislative Council.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Articles 168 to 212 of the Indian Constitution explicitly deal with the governance and structure of the State Legislature.
The State Legislature framework includes provisions for both the Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) and Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad).
These articles outline the organization, composition, officers, duration, procedures, privileges, and powers of state legislative bodies.
